sufficient_sets.text: According to the 50th report of the commissioner for linguistic minorities in India, which was submitted in 2014, Hindi is Delhi's most spoken language, with 80.94% speakers, followed by Punjabi (7.14%), Urdu (6.31%) and Bengali (1.50%). 4.11% speak other languages. Hindi is also the official language of Delhi while Urdu and Punjabi have been declared as additional official languages.
